استلذذت (form X)

# اِسْتَلْذَذْتَ (istalḏaḏta) /is.tal.ðað.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اِسْتَلْذَذْتِ (istalḏaḏti) /is.tal.ðað.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اُسْتُلْذِذْتُ (ustulḏiḏtu) /us.tul.
